title: Submission result
description: What the integrate skill decided about one submission, written to processed/<id>/result.json by `npm run inbox -- close` (docs/submissions.md#results). Reasons are written for the contributor.

status.description: integrated: every counted item accepted or changed. partial: some used, some not. rejected: nothing used. needs-info: nothing integrated until the contributor answers, with a new submission naming this one in replyTo.

pr.description: The content PR, when anything was integrated.

items.description: One decision per item of the submission, in its order.

questions.description: What the contributor must answer (needs-info) or the owner must decide in review.

item.description: submission (the whole of it), entry (an add's draft), change:<path>, file:<name>, field-note:<n> (from 1), or comment.
